questions.q: What is the weighting of Component 3 (Composing) in the IGCSE?
questions.why: Performing and Composing are each 30%; Listening is 40%.

questions.q: Which is NOT allowed for Part 2 (performing with others)?
options: A duet where both parts are equally important
A flute solo with piano accompaniment where you play the flute
Singing a harmony part in a small vocal group
questions.why: An accompanied solo does not show ensemble skills, so it cannot be used for Part 2.

questions.q: What happens if both compositions use the same instruments?
options: Composition 2 gets 0 for Use of medium
questions.why: A different combination of instruments, voices or sounds is required.

questions.q: Give two ways to earn high marks for Structure in a composition. [2]
questions.model: Use clear sections with contrast (e.g. ABA or verse–chorus), and link them with repetition, variation and a planned ending, so the piece feels organised overall.
